verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a zero-trust networking and VPN platform, so AI-generated commit message suggestions from staged changes is a source-control feature outside its product category. Its AI-adjacent items (the Tailscale skill for coding agents, the Aperture gateway and CLI for running agents, LLM request inspection) cover agent connectivity and governance, not commit message generation, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes
